name: pulser audio
changelog:
• Exact Song Click & Name Alignment: Clicking any song in All Tracks or playlists (local & downloaded YouTube Music tracks) plays that exact matching song with 100% matched title, artist, and cover art
• Downloaded Offline Tracks Retained in Shuffle: Downloaded offline songs are fully recognized as local library tracks in shuffle and sequential playback
• Fast Differential Windows Auto-Updates: Includes .blockmap differential chunk metadata for rapid background updates without full package downloads
• Reliable Windows Restart & Clean Teardown: Windows updater closes handles before silent relaunch with zero hang
• Pure Portable Linux AppImage: Seamless background updates with zero root pkexec password prompts
